summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Linktree-style social media link page. All core functionality working perfectly with excellent visual design implementation.

Mobile responsive layout working correctly (tested at 390x844)

Modern glassmorphism card design with backdrop blur effects

No console errors or JavaScript issues detected
